caption: Fig. 1(a) — Morton Z-order curve through element centroids on a 2-D adaptive mesh (schematic). Single-cell (centroid) registration: each element maps to exactly one cell. Red dotted curve: Z-order traversal; numbers: Morton codes. Coarse region (blue, level ell, delta=1); refined region (amber dashed box, level ell+1, delta=0.5). Green arrow: two spatially adjacent centroids near the refinement boundary that are far apart in the 1D Morton ordering — the structural cause of search failures.
description: Print-ready figure for Section 3.4. White background. Morton curve + mesh.
